items.raw_excerpt: This small Ontario town that’s brimming with film sets and history is worth the hour and a half drive from Toronto. Here's what to know.
items.summary_en: Millbrook is a small town in Ontario with 45 historic buildings. It sits about an hour and a half from Toronto. Film crews sometimes use its streets as a movie set.

items.raw_excerpt: Lochlan Gilbert ran all 660 kilometres of the iconic West Australian adventure road in 14 days in a bid to raise money for people experiencing homelessness.
items.summary_en: Lochlan Gilbert ran the famous Gibb River Road in Western Australia. The road is 660 kilometers long, and he finished it in 14 days. He ran through heat stroke and stress fractures to raise money for people without homes.
items.summary_ko: 로클런 길버트가 서호주의 유명한 길 기브 리버 로드를 달렸다. 총 660km인 이 길을 그는 14일 만에 완주했다. 노숙인을 돕기 위해 모금하려고 열사병과 스트레스 골절을 이겨내며 달렸다.

items.title_original: Heat stroke and stress fractures don't stop teen running 660km for charity

items.raw_excerpt: Tasmanians wanting to give up smoking will be given a leg up on their journey with the recent expansion of a free 12-week program offering a wide suite of support.
items.summary_en: Tasmania is expanding a free 12-week quit smoking program. People aged 12 and older can now get nicotine patches and support. The program helps anyone who wants to stop smoking.

items.title_en: Free nicotine patches for Tasmanians as young as 12

items.raw_excerpt: VTV.vn - Các làng nghề truyền thống tại Đà Nẵng đón hơn 220.000 lượt khách từ đầu năm 2026, trong đó khách quốc tế chiếm hơn 80%, góp phần đa dạng sản phẩm du lịch.

items.raw_excerpt: Environmentalists question up to 20,000 trees felled for a solar fence in Chalakudy, urging CEC review and action over alleged irregularities.
items.summary_en: Environmentalists are questioning the felling of up to 20,000 trees for a solar fence in Chalakudy, Kerala. They urge the CEC to review alleged irregularities in the project. Local activists say the tree loss threatens the forest area.

items.title_en: Forest violations questioned in Kerala's Chalakudy division

items.raw_excerpt: Changi Airport and Seletar Airport remain operational, but additional measures will be implemented if the haze situation worsens, the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore and Changi Airport Group said.
items.summary_en: Between October 5 and October 11, haze lowered visibility at Seletar Airport. Sixteen flights were sent to other airports. Officials said Changi Airport kept running, but more steps would be taken if the haze gets worse.
items.summary_ko: 10월 5일부터 11일 사이 스모그로 세레타 공항의 가시거리가 떨어졌다. 항공편 16편이 다른 공항으로 대체 착륙했다. 당국은 창이 공항은 정상 운항 중이지만 스모그가 악화되면 추가 조치를 하겠다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: 16 flights were diverted from Seletar Airport last week as haze cut visibility

items.raw_excerpt: The Victorian firefighters' union is threatening legal action against its own members for not paying a levy to cover its hefty legal costs.
items.summary_en: The firefighters' union in Victoria is threatening legal action against its own members. Some members have not paid a levy that covers the union's hefty legal costs. The union says it needs the money to pay its lawyers.

items.raw_excerpt: A rare ninth-century Gajalakshmi sculpture featuring Samudra Manthan and a 12-armed Nataraja carving has been found neglected in Yanagandla village in Telangana’s Medak district.
items.summary_en: A rare ninth-century Gajalakshmi sculpture was found neglected in Yanagandla village in Medak district, Telangana. The carving shows Samudra Manthan and a 12-armed Nataraja from the Rashtrakuta period.

items.raw_excerpt: This week’s Sweden in Focus Extra features an interview with AI consultant Anna Bärlund, who won an appeal last week against her Swedish citizenship rejection.
